# Dekho Hatke
> Automation, coding, tools and code you can actually use

## Articles
- [Fix Telegram Bot Error 409: Conflict Terminated by Other getUpdates Request](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/telegram-bot-409-conflict-getupdates/): Telegram bot crashing with 409 Conflict? Find the second running copy, clear a stuck webhook and make sure only one instance ever polls.
- [Render Says No Open Ports Detected? Fix Your Flask and Gunicorn Start](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/render-no-open-ports-detected-flask-gunicorn/): Deploy fails with Port scan timeout on Render? Bind to 0.0.0.0 and the PORT variable, fix the gunicorn command and run a bot with a health server.
- [Fix the CORS Error When Your Static Website Calls a Flask API](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/flask-cors-error-static-site-api/): Blocked by CORS policy in the browser console? Learn what preflight is and fix it in Flask, including credentials, redirects and error responses.
- [Fix BeautifulSoup AttributeError: NoneType Object Has No Attribute get_text](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/beautifulsoup-nonetype-no-attribute-get-text/): Why find and select_one return None, how to debug the real HTML your script receives and how to write scraping code that survives missing elements.
- [BeautifulSoup Returns Empty Results? Find the Hidden JSON API Instead](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/scrape-javascript-page-hidden-json-api/): When a page loads data with JavaScript, the HTML you download is empty. Use DevTools to find the JSON request behind the page and call it in Python.
- [Android RecyclerView Blank? Fix No Adapter Attached; Skipping Layout](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/recyclerview-no-adapter-attached-skipping-layout/): A seven point checklist for an empty RecyclerView in Java: adapter, LayoutManager, item count, row layout height, data refresh and ListAdapter traps.
- [Find a C++ Segmentation Fault with AddressSanitizer and gdb](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/cpp-segmentation-fault-asan-gdb/): Stop guessing why your program prints Segmentation fault. Reproduce it, read an AddressSanitizer report, get a gdb backtrace and fix the usual causes.
- [Cron Job Not Running Your Python Script? Seven Causes and Fixes](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/cron-job-not-running-python-script/): Your script works in the terminal but silently does nothing from cron. Fix PATH, working directory, percent signs, time zones and missing logs.
- [Python CSV Shows Garbage Characters in Excel? Use utf-8-sig](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/python-csv-unicode-garbage-excel-utf8-sig/): Hindi text, the rupee sign or accented letters turn into odd symbols when a Python CSV opens in Excel. Understand why and fix it with one argument.
- [Python requests Hangs or Fails Randomly? Timeouts, Retries and Sessions](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/python-requests-timeout-retry-fix/): A script that freezes or breaks on one bad response needs a timeout, a retry policy and a Session. Copy a hardened requests helper for any project.
- [Python Web Scraping with BeautifulSoup](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/python-web-scraping-beautifulsoup/): Learn web scraping with Python, requests and BeautifulSoup: download pages politely, parse HTML, follow pagination and save clean CSV data.
- [Android Java: RecyclerView Step by Step](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/android-java-recyclerview/): Build an Android RecyclerView in Java step by step: adapter, ViewHolder, click handling, adding and removing items, and DiffUtil.
- [JavaScript Fetch API: A Practical Guide](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/javascript-fetch-api-guide/): Learn JavaScript fetch: GET and POST, error handling, timeouts with AbortController, retries and calling your own backend from a static site.
- [C++ Pointers Explained Simply](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/cpp-pointers-explained/): Understand C++ pointers with simple examples: addresses, dereferencing, nullptr, const, new and delete, and smart pointers.
- [Build a Telegram Bot That Reports to You](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/telegram-bot-report-python/): Send alerts, files and error tracebacks from Python to your phone with a Telegram bot. Includes a reusable notifier module and security tips.
- [Schedule Python Scripts with Cron and Render](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/schedule-python-scripts-render/): Schedule Python scripts with cron, a free Render web service or GitHub Actions, with working code, honest limits and security tips.
- [Automate Your Daily Tasks with Python](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/automate-daily-tasks-python/): Automate daily tasks with Python: organise folders, delete old files, rename photos and send reports, using safe dry-run scripts.
